verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Smart Retries automatically retry failed subscription/invoice payments to prevent involuntary churn, plus recovery analytics tracking failure/recovery rates — directly matching the story's core claim. However, evidence doesn't specify the retry cadence is ML- or schedule-optimized versus a fixed/simple retry logic, nor provide independent/hands-on data quantifying measurable churn recovery. missing for 10: documented details on the ML/optimization methodology behind retry timing, independent third-party validation of recovery rate improvements.
